text: {"lessons":["I should base sell decisions on a stock’s outlook and portfolio risk, not on the comfort of locking in gains; repeatedly trimming Stock D may have cut future upside.","Avoid letting loss aversion keep me from acting: selling Stock B at a steep loss was painful, but I should assess each holding objectively rather than anchor to its cost.","A diversified portfolio can still fall substantially, so I should monitor overall exposure and keep a plan for managing risk instead of reacting to each month’s price move."]}
